title: Dispute Filing and Decision Periods, Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay
content:
For each Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay product, the disputes team works to three figures: the number of calendar days after delivery within which a dispute may be filed, the number of calendar days after a dispute within which Paloma decides it, and the most times a delivered token code may be re-sent to the customer.

| Product | Dispute may be filed within (calendar days after delivery) | Paloma decides within (calendar days after the dispute) | Most re-sends of a token code |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | 30 | 10 | 0 |
| Paloma Data Bundle | 30 | 10 | 0 |
| Paloma Electricity Token | 30 | 15 | 3 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | 60 | 30 | 0 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | 60 | 30 | 0 |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | 90 | 30 | 0 |

## Comparisons

- The filing period is 30 calendar days for Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle and Paloma Electricity Token, 60 for Paloma Bill Pay Utilities and Paloma Bill Pay Television, and 90 for Paloma Bill Pay School Fees.
- The decision period is 10 calendar days for Paloma Airtime Top-Up and Paloma Data Bundle, 15 for Paloma Electricity Token, and 30 for the three bill products.
- Only Paloma Electricity Token has token re-sends, up to 3 per order; every other product has 0, as none of them produces a token code.
